# Test vectors for the c2sp.org/tlog-addenda digest indication format.
#
# Each record is one entry and its expected parse result:
#
#   entry HEX       - the full entry bytes, including the trailing index
#   digest HEX      - an expected resolved digest, one line per digest,
#                     in index order (offset_0 first)
#   expect ok       - ParseIndex should succeed and return exactly the
#                     listed digests
#   expect malformed - ParseIndex should return an error
#
# Hex may contain spaces and tabs for grouping; '' means empty.
# Blank lines and lines beginning with # are ignored.
#
# Entry layout, for reference (read from the end, backwards):
#
#   <application content, including the digests> || offset_0 .. offset_{N-1} || N
#
# The final byte is the count N; the N*4 bytes before it are big-endian
# offsets from the start of the entry; each names a 32-byte digest. Below,
# entry hex is grouped as  <content> <offsets> <count>  to make this visible.


# === No addenda ===

# The minimal entry: no content, no digests, just the 0x00 count byte.
entry 00
expect ok

# Application content followed by the single 0x00 count byte.
entry deadbeef  00
expect ok


# === Single digest ===

# Two bytes of application content, then a digest at offset 2.
# offsets: 00000002 ; count: 01
entry cafe\
	aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\
	00000002  01
digest aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
expect ok


# === Multiple digests ===

# Content interleaves the digests: cafe, digest A at offset 2, beef,
# digest B at offset 36 (0x24).
# offsets: 00000002 00000024 ; count: 02
entry cafe\
	aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\
	beef\
	bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb\
	00000002 00000024  02
digest aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
digest bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb
expect ok


# === Digests read from within the application content ===

# The entry body is 40 bytes of plain content (0x00..0x27). Two digests are
# read out of it: one at offset 0, one at offset 8. They overlap each other
# and restate no separate bytes -- the index points into the content rather
# than appending copies of the digests. Overlapping offsets are valid.
# offsets: 00000000 00000008 ; count: 02
entry 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f20212223242526 27\
	00000000 00000008  02
digest 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f
digest 08090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f2021222324252627
expect ok


# === Malformed: unreadable inputs ===

# An empty entry has no count byte.
entry ''
expect malformed

# The count byte says 2 (needs 8 offset bytes) but only one byte precedes it.
entry aa  02
expect malformed

# Count 1, offset 0, but the 7-byte entry cannot hold a 32-byte digest there.
entry cafe  00000000  01
expect malformed

# Count 1, offset 30 (0x1e) into a 40-byte body: the digest's 32 bytes
# (30..62) overrun the end of the 45-byte entry.
entry 000102030405060708090a0b0c0d0e0f101112131415161718191a1b1c1d1e1f20212223242526 27\
	0000001e  01
expect malformed

# Count 1, offset 5 into 32 bytes of content: the digest's 32 bytes (5..37)
# fit the 37-byte entry, but only by reading the offset table and count byte
# as digest bytes. Digests must lie within the application content.
entry aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa\
	00000005  01
expect malformed
